85	func NewCmdEdit(f *cmdutil.Factory, runF func(options *EditOptions) error) *cobra.Command {
86		opts := &EditOptions{
87			IO:       f.IOStreams,
88			Prompter: f.Prompter,
89		}
90	
91		cmd := &cobra.Command{
92			Use:   "edit [<repository>]",
93			Short: "Edit repository settings",
94			Annotations: map[string]string{
95				"help:arguments": heredoc.Doc(`
96					A repository can be supplied as an argument in any of the following formats:
97					- "OWNER/REPO"
98					- by URL, e.g. "https://github.com/OWNER/REPO"
99				`),
100			},
101			Long: heredoc.Docf(`
102				Edit repository settings.
103	
104				To toggle a setting off, use the %[1]s--<flag>=false%[1]s syntax.
105	
106				Note that changing repository visibility to private will cause loss of stars and watchers.
107			`, "`"),
108			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
109			Example: heredoc.Doc(`
110				# enable issues and wiki
111				gh repo edit --enable-issues --enable-wiki
112	
113				# disable projects
114				gh repo edit --enable-projects=false
115			`),
116			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
117				if len(args) > 0 {
118					var err error
119					opts.Repository, err = ghrepo.FromFullName(args[0])
120					if err != nil {
121						return err
122					}
123				} else {
124					var err error
125					opts.Repository, err = f.BaseRepo()
126					if err != nil {
127						return err
128					}
129				}
130	
131				if httpClient, err := f.HttpClient(); err == nil {
132					opts.HTTPClient = httpClient
133				} else {
134					return err
135				}
136	
137				if cmd.Flags().NFlag() == 0 {
138					opts.InteractiveMode = true
139				}
140	
141				if opts.InteractiveMode && !opts.IO.CanPrompt() {
142					return cmdutil.FlagErrorf("specify properties to edit when not running interactively")
143				}
144	
145				if runF != nil {
146					return runF(opts)
147				}
148				return editRun(cmd.Context(), opts)
149			},
150		}

174	func editRun(ctx context.Context, opts *EditOptions) error {
175		repo := opts.Repository
176	
177		if opts.InteractiveMode {
178			detector := opts.Detector
179			if detector == nil {
180				cachedClient := api.NewCachedHTTPClient(opts.HTTPClient, time.Hour*24)
181				detector = fd.NewDetector(cachedClient, repo.RepoHost())
182			}
183			repoFeatures, err := detector.RepositoryFeatures()
184			if err != nil {
185				return err
186			}
187	
188			apiClient := api.NewClientFromHTTP(opts.HTTPClient)
189			fieldsToRetrieve := []string{
190				"defaultBranchRef",
191				"deleteBranchOnMerge",
192				"description",
193				"hasIssuesEnabled",
194				"hasProjectsEnabled",
195				"hasWikiEnabled",
196				// TODO: GitHub Enterprise Server does not support has_discussions yet
197				// "hasDiscussionsEnabled",
198				"homepageUrl",
199				"isInOrganization",
200				"isTemplate",
201				"mergeCommitAllowed",
202				"rebaseMergeAllowed",
203				"repositoryTopics",
204				"stargazerCount",
205				"squashMergeAllowed",
206				"watchers",
207			}
208			if repoFeatures.VisibilityField {
209				fieldsToRetrieve = append(fieldsToRetrieve, "visibility")
210			}
211			if repoFeatures.AutoMerge {
212				fieldsToRetrieve = append(fieldsToRetrieve, "autoMergeAllowed")
213			}
214	
215			opts.IO.StartProgressIndicator()
216			fetchedRepo, err := api.FetchRepository(apiClient, opts.Repository, fieldsToRetrieve)
217			opts.IO.StopProgressIndicator()
218			if err != nil {
219				return err
220			}
221			err = interactiveRepoEdit(opts, fetchedRepo)
222			if err != nil {
223				return err
224			}
225		}
226	
227		apiPath := fmt.Sprintf("repos/%s/%s", repo.RepoOwner(), repo.RepoName())
228	
229		body := &bytes.Buffer{}
230		enc := json.NewEncoder(body)
231		if err := enc.Encode(opts.Edits); err != nil {
232			return err
233		}
234	
235		g := errgroup.Group{}
236	
237		if body.Len() > 3 {
238			g.Go(func() error {
239				apiClient := api.NewClientFromHTTP(opts.HTTPClient)
240				_, err := api.CreateRepoTransformToV4(apiClient, repo.RepoHost(), "PATCH", apiPath, body)
241				return err
242			})
243		}
244	
245		if len(opts.AddTopics) > 0 || len(opts.RemoveTopics) > 0 {
246			g.Go(func() error {
247				// opts.topicsCache gets populated in interactive mode
248				if !opts.InteractiveMode {
249					var err error
250					opts.topicsCache, err = getTopics(ctx, opts.HTTPClient, repo)
251					if err != nil {
252						return err
253					}
254				}
255				oldTopics := set.NewStringSet()
256				oldTopics.AddValues(opts.topicsCache)
257	
258				newTopics := set.NewStringSet()
259				newTopics.AddValues(opts.topicsCache)
260				newTopics.AddValues(opts.AddTopics)
